description: This is a Kotlin class for an Android UI fragment named `CatalogFragment`, which manages the product catalog page in an online shopping app. It handles product display, category filtering, sorting, search with debounce, and recent searches UI.

classes.name: CatalogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of products, supports filtering by category, sorting, search with debounce, and recent searches.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up category filters, sorting, debounced search, recent searches, and restores previous search state.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Removes pending callbacks when the view is destroyed to avoid UI updates on dead views.

methods.name: setupDebouncedSearch
methods.description: Configures the search input to trigger product list refresh with debounce delay.

methods.name: setupSortDropdown
methods.description: Initializes and handles the sorting options dropdown.

methods.name: renderCategoryFilters
methods.description: Generates category filter chips dynamically from repository data.

methods.name: refreshProducts
methods.description: Filters, sorts, and displays products based on current selections.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Filters the product list based on selected category and search query.

methods.name: applySorting
methods.description: Sorts the filtered products based on selected sort option.

methods.name: matchesSearch
methods.description: Checks if a product matches the search query in its name or category.

methods.name: relevanceScore
methods.description: Computes a heuristic relevance score based on how well a product matches the search query.

methods.name: setupRecentSearchesUi
methods.description: Configures recent searches UI, including the clear button.

methods.name: renderRecentSearches
methods.description: Displays recent search queries as clickable chips for quick re-search.

methods.name: applyRecentSearch
methods.description: Updates the search field with a recent query, triggering refresh.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels (px) for UI layout.
